title: [Public Beta] Supabase Knowledge Base
body_markdown:
## What's new#


The[Supabase Knowledge Base](https://supabase.com/kb) is a new home for applied guides: how to fix a specific error, how to move to Supabase from another platform, and how to build a specific scenario.


We're launching with two types of content:


- Troubleshooting guides, now hosted on /kb at[supabase.com/kb/topics/troubleshooting](https://supabase.com/kb/topics/troubleshooting) .
- Migration guides for moving to Supabase from Amazon RDS, Auth0, Firebase, Heroku, MySQL, Neon, Render, and more.


The knowledge base is open source and its source lives in the[supabase/supabase](https://github.com/supabase/supabase) repo for anyone to contribute to.
